ORIGIN.quote: Consequently, the report attributes actions to “clients” or “agents” in the sense used by their own text, not to a particular model or vendor. The repeated OpenAI/ChatGPT labels are suggestive but not reliable provenance.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader does learn that OpenAI-bearing labels pervade the data and that they bear on provenance, but the report's one explicit remark on the question immediately discounts them as unreliable and declines to attribute to any vendor, so the takeaway is that the question is deliberately left unanswered. This sits above 0.2 because the report itself frames the OpenAI labels as (weak) provenance evidence rather than leaving the connection to the reader, and below 0.6 because OpenAI is never left standing as a live possibility — it is raised only to be set aside.
